name: Numeral
summary: Numeral monitors nexus for free and sells registration and filing by the action. Its Professional plan costs $75 per filing and $150 per registration in all US states, and it promises to pay penalties and interest if a return is filed late. Rate calculation through an API sits on a custom Enterprise plan.

facts.text: Numeral guarantees that sales tax is filed on time or it pays the penalties and interest.
The free Monitoring plan includes a nexus study after a seller connects stores or billing platforms, plus alerts when the seller crosses nexus in a new jurisdiction.
Standard accounts are month-to-month with no required contract and can be canceled at any time without penalty.
The pricing section says per filing and per registration, while the FAQ describes a one-time $150 registration fee per state, so the exact billing is worth confirming with Numeral.
Numeral says it covers 90 or more countries, with the global tax engine and API on the Enterprise plan.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Also $150 per registration. Includes autofile, autoregister, a virtual mailbox and exemption certificate management

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Adds global coverage, the tax engine and API, and advanced reporting

hiddenCosts: The first 50 exemption certificates are free, and the page does not state the price after that.

contract.cancellation: Standard month-to-month plans can be canceled at any time without penalty.
